source_detail: Transcribed verbatim from photographs of the restaurant's own printed menu (harvest/menu/gm-002,003,004,009,014,015,016,017,018,019). Delivery-platform prices were NOT used: the Just Eat list runs far above the printed dine-in list (pita gyros 9,90 vs 7,00; moussaka 16,00 vs 12,00).
excluded_source: harvest/menu/gm-007, gm-010, gm-011, gm-013 — the two-sided 'NUOVA APERTURA' promotional leaflet (EXIF 2024-04-19). Its price list is a promotional one and contradicts the binder menu on every comparable line (pita gyros 6,00 / 5,00 on the leaflet vs 7,00 on the printed table menu), one item is struck out by hand, and the leaflet carries two venues. Dish names and descriptions for the 'piatti' and 'insalate' sections are taken from it because those pages of the table menu were not photographed, but none of its prices are published.
allergens: The printed menu carries no allergen information, so this file carries none. Guests must ask staff.
